decisions.Kwic: 雖然「音律不差」，而「下語用字，全不可讀」，也沒有文學價值

Decision.AttributionNote: The Third Dunhuang Manuscript of Shenhui's Recorded Sayings: Miscellaneous Questions and Answers of the Nanyang Preceptor, Collected by Liu Cheng (神會和尚語錄的第三個敦煌寫本：南陽和尚問答雜徵義（劉澄集）), in Hu Shi's modern scholarly postscript on the five-watch songs. Hu Shi is the exact prose author who says that the songs' musical regulation is not deficient but their wording and character choice are unreadable and lack literary value. The inline note credits the following wording judgment to Shen Yifu's Yuefu Zhimi; Shenhui is the manuscript subject, not the speaker of this modern sentence.
